item.description:
Features

  • Custom break sounds: choose a built-in sound, a system sound or upload your own for the start and end of a break, and preview it right in the Sound Effects settings.

Bugfixes

  • Fixed DeskRest sometimes acting as if a Focus mode was still active after the Focus had already been turned off while the app wasn't running.
  • Fixed a memory leak that made DeskRest use more memory and CPU after every break the longer it ran.
